_comment: Reference sheets. Render with comic_render.py --queue out/sheets.json.

jobs.prompt: a clean reference sheet on white paper. Style: comic panel, razor-sharp confident brush-and-ink line, pristine architectural perspective, crisp silhouettes, clean expressive character geometry, generous negative space. a reference swatch sheet for a masterwork-era comic strip: samples of razor-sharp confident brush-and-ink line with clean architectural perspective, a crisp silhouette, a close-up hand with zero crosshatching, wet-on-wet watercolor samples of gray-green moss, coastal fog, rusted galvanized tin and a bruised dusk sky with water bleeding over an ink edge, a desaturated Payne's gray and raw umber swatch, and a tiny three-legged scruff of ink asleep beside a flat horizontal stroke; labeled ERA III 2012–2020. Neat hand-lettered labels are allowed on this sheet.
jobs.negative: photorealistic, 3D render, airbrush, neon, anime, watermark, extra fingers
